You cannot change shape to a form more than one size category smaller or larger than your original form. data.name: Change Shape

raw_tokens.value: Ability Benefit|(2 forms, both of which must be Tiny animals; beast shape II)

You have the ability to assume the appearance of a specific type of creature, but retain most of your own physical qualities. You cannot change shape to a form more than one size category smaller or larger than your original form. This ability functions as a polymorph spell, but you do not adjust your ability scores (although you gain any other abilities of the creature you mimic).
